jobs.title: Office & HR Administration Manager/in  (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir suchen eine herzliche, strukturierte und proaktive Persönlichkeit , die unser Office zu einem Ort macht, an dem sich alle wohlfühlen und gerne arbeiten – und die gleichzeitig administrative HR-Prozesse zuverlässig und mit einem guten Gespür für Menschen unterstützt. Wenn du Spaß daran hast, Ordnung, Energie und gute Stimmung ins Team zu bringen , dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Wer wir sind Wir sind Europas Marktführer im Bereich Hindernislaufveranstaltungen – mit Leidenschaft und Sitz in Berlin. Mit unseren Events XLETIX Challenge , Muddy Angel Run und XLETIX Kids begeistern wir jährlich über 250.000 Teilnehmende in Deutschland, Österreich und in der Schweiz. Unsere Mission: Menschen durch Sport zu begeistern und damit unvergessliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen. Deine Aufgaben Office Management & Organisation Du hältst unser Office am Laufen – von Material- und Getränkebestellungen über die Organisation von Dienstleister/innen bis zur Bearbeitung des Posteingangs. Du behältst Office-Verträge, Lieferanten und Budgets im Blick und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft. Du kümmerst dich darum, dass unser Arbeitsplatz immer optimal ausgestattet ist – funktional, einladend, gut organisiert und den Anforderungen des Arbeitsschutzes entsprechend. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für organisatorische Fragen rund um unser Office und sorgst dafür, dass sich Mitarbeitende und Besucher/innen bei uns gut aufgehoben fühlen. HR Administration & People Operations Du unterstützt das People & Culture Team bei administrativen HR-Prozessen entlang des Mitarbeitendenzyklus – vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt. Du koordinierst das organisatorische Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender und sorgst dafür, dass alle wichtigen Informationen, Unterlagen, Zugänge und Materialien rechtzeitig vorbereitet sind. Du unterstützt bei Vertragsangelegenheiten, beispielsweise bei der Vorbereitung von Vertragsunterlagen, Vertragsänderungen und weiteren administrativen Dokumenten. Du pflegst und aktualisie

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description: About Us At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging. We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a recognised leader in data and analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses. The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the culture, and what algo1 becomes. The Role We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on People Operations Manager to help us build and run the people side of algo1 as we grow. This is a remote, part-time role, working approximately 3-4 hours each day, five days a week. There will be the occasional need to visit our London office to meet key colleagues. You’ll report to our Chief Operating Officer and work closely with our leadership team and hiring managers across the business. We need someone who is equally comfortable handling the day-to-day essentials of HR administration and providing thoughtful, practical support on broader people matters. One day you might be preparing a contract, organising onboarding or updating employee records. The next, you could be helping a manager prepare for a performance review, working through a people issue or improving one of our HR processes. You’ll ideally have worked in a startup or small, fast-growing business before, so you’ll understand that there isn’t always a playbook. You’ll know when to follow a process, when to improve one, and when to use your judgement to find a pragmatic solution. This is a role for someone who enjoys getting things done, takes pride in the details and wants to make a meaningful contribution to a grow

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Lead – Fulfillment - Mexico
jobs.description: About the Role As a Strategic Sourcing Lead, you’ll lead a new global sourcing hub focused on finding the right contributors for complex AI projects that require specialized or hard-to-reach talent across a wide range of domains, from translation and localization to legal, medical, scientific, and technical fields. This is a strategic, hands-on role within Fulfillment. You’ll define how the hub operates, develop the team, and partner with Recruitment and Delivery to build sourcing strategies ranging from complex searches to high-volume scaling. The team will work in a data-informed and AI-enabled environment, using technology to enhance research, outreach, analysis, and sourcing efficiency. Your Impact Design and execute creative sourcing strategies for specialized, hard-to-reach, and high-volume needs. Partner with Recruitment and Delivery to assess requirements, sourcing feasibility, and project needs. Build relationships with production stakeholders and communicate risks, timelines, and expectations. Use sourcing and conversion data to identify bottlenecks, test approaches, and improve funnel performance. Embed AI and automation into sourcing workflows to improve research, outreach, analysis, efficiency, and scalability. What You Bring 5+ years of experience in sourcing, recruitment, talent acquisition, or a related field. Experience leading or mentoring sourcing teams in a fast-paced environment. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across teams. Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to guide sourcing decisions. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Nice to Haves Experience sourcing for AI, data, or crowdsourcing projects. Experience sourcing linguists, translators, or other language profiles across markets. Experience working with global or distributed teams across time zones. Flexibility to work regular U.S. hours or provide U.S. overlap when working in a different time zone. Compensation Additional Informat

jobs.title: Tech Recruiter
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Anderco
